sources.name: Official CG:SHOP 2023 input archive
sources.metadata: The instance has 92 boundary vertices and no holes.

sources.name: Shadoks CG:SHOP 2023 solution viewer
sources.scope: A Shadoks-team public report. The SVG displays rounded coordinates. Nearby integer coordinates were inferred and exactly validated as one feasible same-count 15-piece witness; the original submitted coordinates are not recovered uniquely. This is not a global-optimum certificate.

sources.name: Official CG:SHOP 2023 aggregate ranking
sources.scope: The ranking lists aggregate team scores only. It does not publish per-instance values. DIKU (AMW) ranks first overall and Shadoks second overall.

sources.name: Minimum Coverage by Convex Polygons: The CG:SHOP Challenge 2023
sources.scope: The challenge article describes exact validation and the winning teams' algorithms. It treats best values as submitted solutions and does not claim that socg_fixed92 is globally solved.

sources.name: Shadoks CG:SHOP 2023 source repository
sources.scope: Repository head snapshot checked on 2026-11-06; used as a source-code link for the published team's method, not executed to produce this witness.

sources.name: Covering Polygons is Even Harder
sources.scope: Shows that minimum convex covers can require irrational coordinates of unbounded algebraic degree on some rational polygons. This supports keeping all-real-coordinate semantics.

sources.name: Peeling Rotten Potatoes for a Faster Approximation of Convex Cover
sources.scope: Submitted 2026-04-20. Gives an O(log n)-approximation algorithm; it does not report a proof for this fixed instance.

sources.name: An Overview of Minimum Convex Cover and Maximum Hidden Set, v2
sources.scope: Revised 2026-04-28. Reviewed for results on this fixed instance; no global optimality proof located.

public_record_limitations: The official competition page publishes only aggregate team rankings. The Shadoks viewer contains its own per-instance witnesses, but no complete all-team per-instance archive was found. Therefore 15 is a verified public witness from the checked Shadoks source, not a claim that it is the best result from every team.
